children: Overview
France staffing firm's H1 2026 revenue rose 8% yr/yr, driven by acquisitions and Southern Europe
EBITDA for H1 2026 fell 2.8% due to competition and acquisition integration costs
Net profit for H1 2026 declined 10% yr/yr as operating profit fell and acquisition charges weighed
Outlook
SYNERGIE says it enters H2 2026 with caution amid economic and geopolitical uncertainty
Company says integration of Swiss and Canadian acquisitions supports H2 2026 outlook
SYNERGIE remains confident in its ability to pursue its growth trajectory in H2 2026
Result Drivers
ACQUISITIONS - Co said revenue growth was driven by acquisitions in Canada and Switzerland, which generated €89.6 mln scope effect
SOUTHERN EUROPE - Revenue growth was supported by strong performance in Italy and Spain
COMPETITION AND ACQUISITION COSTS - Co said EBITDA decline was mainly due to increased competition, unfavorable prior-year non-recurring items, and integration costs from acquisitions
